faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA works in WhatsApp and Telegram as well as on the web, so you can text it tasks the same way. The difference is that GAIA also sees your email and calendar when it acts.
faqs.question: Can I text GAIA like I text Instinct?

faqs.answer: Instinct is the faster handoff for a single errand by text. GAIA is the better pick when the errand touches your schedule, your inbox, or your tasks, because it already holds that context.
faqs.question: When is Instinct the better choice?

intro: Instinct nailed one thing: handing off an errand by text. You message it about a trip or a task, and it handles the back-and-forth. GAIA respects that habit and meets you in WhatsApp and Telegram too. The difference is what happens around the text. GAIA reads your inbox, checks your calendar, and remembers how you work, so the errand connects to the rest of your life instead of floating alone.
